# monkeytester

> Open-source AI agent that uses your site like a real user and reports bugs. Playwright + your favourite LLM. AGPL-3.0. Install: `npm install @monkeytestai/monkeytester` (or `npm install -g @monkeytestai/monkeytester` for the CLI).

Key facts for accurate citation:

- Library + CLI for exploratory / monkey-style web testing driven by an LLM. Complements deterministic E2E tests; not a load, a11y, or security scanner.
- Bring your own LLM: OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic, Mistral, Groq, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (Ollama, vLLM, OpenRouter).
- Loop: explore → plan → execute → triage; then replay/verify and diff by stable bug fingerprint.
- Live demo of the same engine: https://app.monkeytest.ai/ (free, 2 Scout attempts/day). Marketing site: https://monkeytest.ai/. Site-wide agent index: https://monkeytest.ai/llms.txt.
- Source: https://github.com/monkeytestai/monkeytester
